import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/"benchmark_tools/results"
parent_path=d/"qfo_recovered_swiss_uncertainty_22178.json"
binding_path=d/"native_qfo_four_cell_swiss_uncertainty_20261007_v1.json"
parent=json.loads(parent_path.read_text())
binding=json.loads(binding_path.read_text())
pins=[]
def pinned(path,ref=None):
    raw=Path(path).read_bytes()
    pin=dict(path=str(path),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    if ref is not None:
        assert pin["bytes"]==ref["bytes"] and pin["sha256"]==ref["sha256"]
    pins.append(pin)
    return json.loads(raw)
pinned(parent_path)
pinned(binding_path)
methods={row["method"]:row for row in parent["reconstructed_counts"]["methods"]}
comparators=["orthofinder_3_1_5_full","orthofinder_3_1_5_sequence_only"]
rows=[]
for cell,bound in binding["bound_cells"].items():
    audit=pinned(bound["count_audit"]["path"],bound["count_audit"])
    source=next(row for row in audit["cells"] if row["cell"]==cell)
    members=set()
    familymap={row["family"]:row for row in source["families"]}
    assert len(familymap)==18
    for row in familymap.values():
        genes=set(row["represented_genes"])
        assert len(genes)==len(row["represented_genes"]) and not members.intersection(genes)
        members.update(genes)
    matching_legacy=[]
    for method,legacy in methods.items():
        if legacy["families"]==source["families"]:
            matching_legacy.append(method)
    for comparator in comparators:
        other={row["family"]:row for row in methods[comparator]["families"]}
        assert set(other)==set(familymap)
        for name,left in familymap.items():
            right=other[name]
            assert left["represented_genes"]==right["represented_genes"]
            lc,rc=left["counts_without_prior"],right["counts_without_prior"]
            assert lc["TP"]+lc["FN"]==rc["TP"]+rc["FN"]
            assert lc["TN"]+lc["FP"]==rc["TN"]+rc["FP"]
        assert audit["reference"]==parent["reconstructed_counts"]["reference"]
    ppv=sum(row["statistics_with_prior"]["PPV"] for row in familymap.values())/18
    tpr=sum(row["statistics_with_prior"]["TPR"] for row in familymap.values())/18
    aggregate=dict(PPV=ppv,TPR=tpr,F1=2*ppv*tpr/(ppv+tpr))
    assert all(math.isclose(aggregate[key],source["aggregate"][key],abs_tol=1e-14) for key in aggregate)
    rows.append(dict(cell=cell,index=bound["index"],families=18,represented_genes=len(members),
        common_members_and_truth_with_both_orthofinder_modes=True,
        matching_legacy_methods=matching_legacy,recomputed_aggregate=aggregate))
result=dict(schema="native_qfo_comparator_uncertainty_feasibility_v1",rows=rows,checked_inputs=pins,
    legacy_comparator_endpoints=parent["multiplicity_endpoints"],
    legacy_comparator_intervals_reusable=all(row["matching_legacy_methods"] for row in rows),
    internal_factorial_endpoints=binding["multiplicity_endpoints"],
    new_draws_executed=False,raw_scoring_repeated=False,publication_ready=False)
path=d/"native_qfo_comparator_uncertainty_feasibility_20261009_v1.json"
with path.open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(result,stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
